1. Open the plastic retaining band with the rigid section of the air delivery pipe to the exchanger.

2. Disconnect the pipe from the engine oil vapour separator.

3. Disconnect the pipe from the air intake pipe to the turbocharger.

4. Remove the pipe from the engine oil vapour separator.

Refitting

Removing

- Fit the pipe from the engine oil vapour separator to the intake.

- Connect the oil vapour pipe to the air intake pipe to the turbocharger and engine oil vapour separator.

- Secure the air delivery pipe oil vapour pipe to the exchanger using the plastic retaining band.
